## Checklist

- [ ] Source URL is pinned to a commit (for copied components): <!-- link + commit -->
- [ ] License is verified from the source repository, and its name is stated in the entry: <!-- e.g. MIT -->

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm run test`, `npm run validate:registry` and `npm run build` pass
- [ ] `npm run gen:provenance` was run and `provenance.json` and `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` are up to date (if registry sources changed)
